stage: Repeated mixed-control circuits and universal finite-controller recurrence

analytic_results.ideal_probability: 2 sin^2(n theta_plus)/(6+sqrt(2)) + 2 sin^2(n theta_minus)/(6-sqrt(2)), sin^2 theta_plus/minus=(6+/-sqrt(2))/8
analytic_results.irrationality: Each squared trace has nonintegral quadratic norm 1/2, excluding a root-of-unity eigenvalue ratio.
analytic_results.return_mean: 6/17 for every positive integer return exponent
analytic_results.robust_threshold: Discrepancy >1/3 infinitely often on common return depths, independently of matching and preparation.
analytic_results.universal_exponent: Q_M = lcm(1,...,M) for at most M retained frame labels
analytic_results.explicit_search_bound: Among n=Q_M*r for 1<=r<=36*4^Q_M+1, at least one has discrepancy >1/3. This huge bound is analytic, not computed for large M.
analytic_results.liminf: Return-subsequence discrepancy also has liminf zero; there is no all-large-depth positive lower bound.
analytic_results.refinement: Fixed-depth error tends to zero for uniformly accurate refinements, but selected depths growing with catalogue size retain discrepancy >1/3. Onset near sqrt(L) is not established.

assumptions: Fixed finite frame catalogue at each resolution
Unchanged compensated seed and physical input 00 in every context
Uninterrupted coherent execution without reduction or reset
